inlines.text: 第三季度搜索收入增长约12%，低于分析师预期的15%，这一缺口或许指向谷歌核心业务的某种紧张关系。AI驱动的搜索查询增长迅速，但带来的收入仍少于传统搜索。

blocks.text: 谷歌在财报电话会上部分证实了这一点。高管Philipp Schindler表示，“AI模式查询的强劲增长因变现率较低而产生了影响”，此外还有其他因素。不过公司仍表示对整体走势满意，并称搜索查询的年增长率达到五年来最高水平。

blocks.text: 而部分真相是，传统搜索多年来一直被宣告死亡，却始终在增长。本季度增速略低于预期，但与近年水平一致，而且谷歌才刚刚开始对AI模式变现。电话会上，公司宣布计划在美国及国际市场扩大其聊天机器人广告项目。

blocks.text: CEO Sundar Pichai表示，Gemini应用用户已达10亿，成为公司历史上增长最快的产品。这并不令人意外，因为它本质上只是搜索的附加功能，而搜索本身规模已经极其庞大。谷歌自家模型的API每分钟处理近320亿个token，是一年前的四倍多。这一跃升部分可能反映的是推理模型和智能体工作流带来的token膨胀，而不只是使用量增加。

blocks.text: 云业务负责人Thomas Kurian预计，AI智能体将推动云业务进一步增长，因为投入生产的智能体越多，其任务需要越多算力、智能体记忆需要越多存储、推理需要越多数据库容量。

blocks.text: 谷歌有望在两端受益：既通过自家消费产品，也通过其他公司运行所依赖的基础设施。Pichai表示，公司正在构建新Carbon模型的更小蒸馏版本，以平衡质量与响应速度，并计划通过常开的云端运行时向“数十亿”用户提供服务。完整的Carbon模型初期只会提供给部分网络安全专家和美国政府。

blocks.text: Search revenue grew about 12 percent in the third quarter, missing the 15 percent analysts had expected, and the shortfall might point to a tension in Google's core business. AI-powered search queries are growing fast but still generate less money than traditional search.

blocks.text: And part of the truth is that traditional search has been declared dead for years and keeps growing anyway. This quarter's growth rate was slightly below expectations but in line with recent years, and Google is only beginning to monetize AI mode. On the call, the company announced plans to expand its ad program for chatbots in the U.S. and internationally.

blocks.text: CEO Sundar Pichai said the Gemini app has reached one billion users, making it the fastest-growing product in the company's history. That is hardly a surprise, given that it is essentially a search add-on, and search is already huge. Google's APIs for its own models process nearly 32 billion tokens per minute, more than four times as many as a year ago. Part of that jump likely reflects token inflation driven by reasoning models and agentic workflows rather than higher usage alone.

blocks.text: The cloud division grew 103 percent year over year to $30.7 billion, and Google is spending accordingly. Capital expenditures hit $51.4 billion in the third quarter alone. The full-year 2026 forecast remains at $195 billion to $205 billion, with a "significantly higher" figure expected for 2027.

blocks.text: Cloud chief Thomas Kurian expects AI agents to drive further growth in the cloud business, since more agents in production require more compute for their tasks, more storage for agent memory, and more database capacity for reasoning, he said.

blocks.text: Google stands to gain on both sides, through its own consumer products and through the infrastructure other companies run on. Pichai said the company is building smaller, distilled versions of its new Carbon model that balance quality and response speed, and plans to serve them to "billions" of users through an always-on cloud runtime. The full Carbon model will initially go only to selected cybersecurity experts and the U.S. government.
